argv.reason: the transcript's first line records the capture's own command line: the trapezoidal 12x3 cutDepth and the six profile axials, as ThreadSpec reports them, in argv[2..8]. With them the "232 trap" measurement reproduces byte for byte against v4.0.0-kernel.2. argv[1] is the nut BREP, which is not in the repository (see transcript_only below), so the name here is a placeholder that keeps argc at 9.

rerun_drop.reason: what the probe prints when argv[1] does not resolve, which it cannot, because the nut was serialized out of a Swift run and never committed.

transcript_only.reason: the internal hex-nut goes through applyThreadCut's boolean path, so the probe re-measures the Swift-built shape rather than rebuilding it. That shape was never committed, so this measurement cannot be re-derived and nothing may cite it as verified (#2824).
